prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

descriptions.rgb: Across all five frames, the camera wearer is seated or standing at the near edge of a rectangular conference table, with the tabletop and nearby chairs within about 0.3–1 m, a large monitor roughly 1–1.5 m ahead-left, and a glass wall behind the people about 2–3 m away. A man in a dark gray shirt and cap sits across the table about 1.5–2 m from the camera, usually near the center or right of view, facing mostly leftward or forward and only intermittently oriented toward the camera wearer. A man in sunglasses and a patterned jacket sits roughly 1–1.5 m to the gray-shirted man's right and about 1.5–2 m from the camera; he is most visible in frames 1–3, faces generally toward the camera side of the table, and becomes partly or fully cropped as the viewpoint turns. In frame 3, a woman in a green top appears farther right, about 2 m from the camera and within roughly 0.5–1 m of the patterned-jacket man; she faces left across the table and is mostly out of view in the other frames. Bottles, yellow objects, papers, remotes, cables, and computer equipment lie on the table within arm's reach of one or more seated people, while a hand or forearm from the camera wearer briefly enters the lower foreground in frames 3–4 and partly occludes the table. Across the sequence the viewpoint pans left and right rather than clearly approaching or retreating, shifting the monitor between left and center and alternately cropping the people at the right edge; the table and equipment remain at approximately constant distances.
